item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 20/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers and thunderstorms to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China in the next few days. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China on Sunday. The weather will be slightly cooler over the region early to midweek next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Soulik will move across Laos and dissipate gradually today. Meanwhile, Tropical Cyclone Pulasan will move across eastern China and weaken gradually.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Sunny intervals during the day. Showers will be heavier over some areas with thunderstorms later.

PSR: Medium High
